find:
if request.headers.get("Host", "") not in allowed:
            return JSONResponse({"refusal": "not addressed here"}, FORBIDDEN)
why: a request carrying another host must be refused before its handler runs, so a write lands nothing

find:
if origin is not None and origin not in origins:
            return JSONResponse({"refusal": "not from this page"}, FORBIDDEN)
why: a write carrying another page's origin must be refused before its handler runs, so the cross-site write lands nothing
a request addressed as localhost or [::1] must be answered by the middleware, not only by the helper
